map.常见象棋杀法的成杀条件与要点速查，含基础杀法、组合杀法与经典残局；不含棋盘输入与: Quick reference of mating conditions and key points for basic patterns, combinations and classic studies; no board input or move solver.
map.按「基础杀法 / 组合杀法 / 经典残局」三个分类渲染速查卡：每卡输出名称、成杀: Renders reference cards in three groups — basic patterns, combinations and classic studies. Each card shows its name, mating condition and 2-3 key points, and clicking expands or collapses the points. Viewed pattern names are recorded locally, deduplicated, ranked by view count and drawn as a top-8 bar chart, keeping at most 30 entries. The page has no board input and does not calculate or verify any concrete move.
map.按中国象棋通行杀法理论整理成杀条件与要点，用于复盘时快速回忆“重炮、闷宫、马后炮: Mating conditions and key points are organized from standard Chinese chess mating theory, to help recall the prerequisites of patterns such as the double cannon, smothered palace, horse-behind-cannon and iron gate bolt during review. Card content is teaching material, not game-score moves; for concrete moves and legality rely on official scores, rules and an actual board.
map.杀法核心是“先控路、后将军”：先把将的退路封死，再用连续将军完成绝杀。上表只列关: The core idea is "control the lines first, check later": seal the general's escape squares before finishing with consecutive checks. The table lists only the key pieces and a one-line point, with no concrete moves.
map.双炮同线、将门被封等前提达成: prerequisites such as double cannons on one file and the general gate sealed
map.先控路后将军，次序不可颠倒: control escape squares first, then check; the order cannot be reversed
map.经典残局的攻防要点: Attacking and defending ideas in classic studies
map.攻防思路参照古谱，不着录具体着法: ideas follow classic manuals; no move sequences listed
map.象棋杀法要点速查：收录基础杀法、组合杀法与经典残局的成杀条件和关键提示，点击展开: Chinese chess mating-pattern quick reference: mating conditions and key points for basic patterns, combinations and classic studies; click a card to expand its points.
map.基础杀法卡：给出每类杀法的成杀条件，例如重炮要求「双炮同线且前炮能借后炮作架」。: Basic-pattern cards give the mating condition for each pattern; for example the double cannon requires both cannons on one file with the front one screening behind the rear.
map.组合杀法卡：说明马炮、车炮配合的先后次序与成立前提，例如马后炮要先控斜线退路、再: Combination cards explain the order and prerequisites of horse-cannon or chariot-cannon cooperation; for example the horse-behind-cannon first controls the diagonal escape squares, then drops the cannon.
map.经典残局卡：七星聚会、野马操田、千里独行等名局的攻防要点，只列条件与思路，不着录: Classic-study cards cover attacking and defending ideas in famous positions such as Seven Stars Gathering, Wild Horse Tills the Field and Lone Rider Travels a Thousand Miles; they list only conditions and ideas, not move sequences.
map.重炮成杀条件速查: Double cannon: mating condition at a glance
map.第一张卡「重炮」：成杀条件 = 双炮在同一线路叠放、前炮能借后炮为炮架将军、黑将: The first card, double cannon: condition = both cannons on one file, the front cannon checks using the rear one as a screen, and the black general has no escape; key point = seal the gate before dropping the cannon, avoiding capture of the rear cannon or dismantling of the screen; note = the card states conditions only, not moves. Check these three items during review, then verify on a real board.
map.本页会给出具体着法吗？: Does this page give concrete moves?
map.不会。页面只列成杀条件与要点，不计算或验证任何着法；具体着法请对照棋谱、规则与棋: No. The page only lists mating conditions and key points and does not calculate or verify moves; consult game scores, the rules and an actual board for concrete moves.
map.满足成杀条件就一定能杀吗？: Does satisfying the mating condition guarantee a mate?
map.不一定。条件是必要前提，还要看先后次序、对方应手与子力是否被牵制；条件成立只说明: Not necessarily. The condition is a necessary prerequisite; the order, the opponent's replies and whether pieces are pinned also matter. Satisfying it only means a mate is possible.
map.怎么用于实战复盘？: How do I use it when reviewing a game?
map.先按名称找到对应卡片，把成杀条件逐条对照当前棋盘：哪些已满足、哪些还差一手，再决: Find the card by name, then check each mating condition against the current board: which are already met and which need one more move, then decide whether to calculate further.
map.千里独行: Lone Rider Travels a Thousand Miles
map.成杀条件：双炮同线且前炮能借后炮作架: Mating condition: both cannons on one file with the front cannon using the rear one as a screen
map.要点：先控制将门再落炮，避免后炮被吃或炮架被拆: Key point: seal the general's gate before dropping the cannon; avoid the rear cannon being captured or the screen dismantled
map.注意：本卡只讲成杀条件，不提供具体着法: Note: this card states only the mating condition, not concrete moves
map.成杀条件：将在宫中被己方子力堵住、炮有可用炮架: Mating condition: the general is blocked inside the palace by its own pieces and the cannon has a usable screen
map.要点：先用车或兵封住将门，再落炮形成闷杀: Key point: seal the gate with a chariot or pawn first, then drop the cannon for the smothered mate
map.注意：炮架被移走或士被兑掉时杀法失效: Note: the mate fails if the screen is moved away or the advisor is traded off
map.成杀条件：帅将同线且中间无子: Mating condition: the red and black generals face each other on one file with no piece between
map.要点：先扫清同线子力，再用车或兵将军: Key point: clear the file first, then check with a chariot or pawn
map.注意：同线一旦被垫子，帅力即失效: Note: once a piece interposes on that file, the facing-generals power disappears
map.成杀条件：双车能分别控制将的上下两条退路: Mating condition: the two chariots can separately control the general's upper and lower escape squares
map.要点：两车各占一翼，先逼将离位再合击: Key point: put one chariot on each wing, force the general out of position, then attack together
map.注意：单车被兑或一车被牵制时不能成立: Note: it fails if one chariot is traded off or pinned
map.成杀条件：车能安全落到花心、守子被牵制: Mating condition: a chariot can land safely on the palace center while the defender is pinned
map.要点：先用弃子或将军引离守子，再落车: Key point: first lure the defender away with a sacrifice or check, then land the chariot
map.注意：花心有守子且未被引离时不可强行落车: Note: do not force the chariot onto the center while a defender occupies it unpinned
map.成杀条件：马控将的斜线退路、炮与将同线且隔一子: Mating condition: the horse controls the general's diagonal escape squares and the cannon is on the same file with one piece between
map.要点：马先占位控路，炮后落；马位比炮位更关键: Key point: position the horse to control the line first and drop the cannon afterwards; the horse's square matters more than the cannon's
map.注意：马位被将吃掉或炮架不足时杀法不成立: Note: the mate fails if the general captures the horse or the screen is insufficient
map.成杀条件：车能封住将门、炮能沉底将军: Mating condition: a chariot can seal the general's gate and the cannon can check along the bottom rank
map.要点：先封门再沉炮，顺序反了会被将先逃: Key point: seal the gate before dropping the cannon; reversing the order lets the general escape first
map.注意：将门被垫子或车被兑掉时失效: Note: it fails if the gate is interposed or the chariot is traded off
map.成杀条件：两炮分别控制中路与底线: Mating condition: the two cannons separately control the central file and the bottom rank
map.要点：先中路后沉底，配合车或兵封门: Key point: take the center first, then the bottom rank, with a chariot or pawn sealing the gate
map.注意：中路炮被牵制时只剩单炮，难以成杀: Note: if the central cannon is pinned, a single cannon rarely mates
map.成杀条件：马能占住将门斜线的关键点: Mating condition: the horse can occupy the key point on the general's gate diagonal
map.要点：马先控路不急于将军，车炮随后合击: Key point: the horse controls the line first without checking, then chariot and cannon strike together
map.注意：马位被逐或将被引离原宫时需重算: Note: recalculate if the horse is driven away or the general leaves the original palace
map.成杀条件：马控住将的上方退路、另有车炮配合: Mating condition: the horse controls the general's upper escape squares with chariot and cannon support
map.要点：马先控路，车炮再将军；不要先动车打草惊蛇: Key point: the horse controls the line first, then chariot and cannon check; do not move the chariot early and alert the opponent
map.注意：马位过高而失去控制点时杀法失效: Note: the mate fails if the horse sits too high and loses its control point
map.成杀条件：红方需连续弃子引离黑方守子: Mating condition: red must sacrifice pieces repeatedly to lure black's defenders away
map.要点：兵行要道、车炮配合，次序极关键: Key point: the pawn takes the key route while chariot and cannon cooperate; the order is critical
map.注意：变化极深，须对照棋谱逐着核算，本页不列着法: Note: the variations are very deep; check move by move against the game score — this page lists no moves
map.成杀条件：马控将门、兵能进到底线: Mating condition: the horse controls the gate and the pawn can reach the bottom rank
map.要点：兵先占要道，马再控路，次序不能颠倒: Key point: the pawn occupies the key route first, then the horse controls the line; the order cannot be reversed
map.注意：马兵配合需精确算路，错一着即和: Note: horse-pawn cooperation needs exact calculation; one wrong move turns it into a draw
map.成杀条件：兵能制住卒、车占住要道: Mating condition: the pawn can restrain the enemy pawn and the chariot holds the key route
map.要点：先以兵制卒，再以车控将门: Key point: restrain the pawn with your pawn first, then control the gate with the chariot
map.注意：车被牵制或兵被吃时局势反转: Note: the position reverses if the chariot is pinned or the pawn is captured
map.成杀条件：卒过河后逼近九宫、车被逼让位: Mating condition: the pawn crosses the river and approaches the palace, forcing the chariot to give way
map.要点：卒逐步推进，逼车离开要道: Key point: advance the pawn step by step and drive the chariot off the key line
map.注意：卒未过河或车占住关键线时不能成立: Note: it cannot work if the pawn has not crossed the river or the chariot holds the critical line
